name: opsbuddy-fix-scripts
description: Script-driven autonomous incident response for a failed Databricks job in the ai-sdlc-devops repo: opsbuddy-fix (11-phase orchestrator), databricks-debug (diagnosis + adversarial root-cause double-check), testing (static validation), and pr-review-opsbuddy-fix (Mode A PR review). Uses GitHub + Slack + this repo's own workflow/*.py scripts and the live Atlassian Jira MCP -- not a bundled MCP server. Only functions when the ai-sdlc-devops repo (or one with an identical workflow/ layout) is the current project.
